decisions.reason: Changing the physical breakout pitch to 1.27 mm does not alter the ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments or pin-availability rules.
The breakout-hole pitch does not change the I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or cable assumptions.
The breakout pitch decision does not modify the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitances.
The panel-input GPIO assignments and connector mounting remain unchanged by the breakout pitch.
The 1.27 mm value refers to the ESP32 through-hole breakout, not the independently specified JST-PH battery connector pitch.
The breakout pitch does not affect the standalone regulator, its capacity, source selection, or powered load.
The source changes the ESP32 breakout pitch only and does not change any sensor-board connector type, pitch, pinout, or count.
The physical breakout pitch does not modify the switched 5V rail, its GPIO control, converter, or powered loads.
The breakout pitch has no necessary effect on the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or 3.3V power path.
The ESP32 breakout pitch does not alter the separate LED board's LED count, model, package, or color format.
The breakout pitch does not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.

Although a smaller breakout pitch may aid routing, the source does not necessarily change the board dimensions, connector placement, ESP32 edge placement, or other recorded mechanical-layout requirements.
